by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ s A B C D E hA hB hC hD hBD hs hE
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  haveI : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2) := ⟨Module.Basis.orientation (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℝ V Fact.out)⟩
  have hsum : EuclideanGeometry.angle B A D + EuclideanGeometry.angle D C B = Real.pi := by
    have hmB := left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ B D
    have hmD := right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ B D
    have hAB : A ≠ B := fun h => hs.2.1 (h ▸ hmB)
    have hAD : A ≠ D := fun h => hs.2.1 (h ▸ hmD)
    have hCB : C ≠ B := fun h => hs.2.2 (h ▸ hmB)
    have hCD : C ≠ D := fun h => hs.2.2 (h ▸ hmD)
    have hn1 : ¬Collinear ℝ ({B, A, D} : Set P) := fun hcol =>
      hs.2.1 (hcol.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hBD)
    have hn2 : ¬Collinear ℝ ({D, C, B} : Set P) := fun hcol =>
      hs.2.2 (hcol.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hBD)
    have h2 := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.two_zsmul_oangle_eq hB hA hC hD hAB hAD hCB hCD
    have hsign := hs.oangle_sign_eq_neg hmB hmD
    have hsign' : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle D C B).sign = (EuclideanGeometry.oangle B A D).sign := by
      rw [EuclideanGeometry.oangle_rev, Real.Angle.sign_neg, hsign, neg_neg]
    have hsum : (2 : ℤ) • (EuclideanGeometry.oangle B A D + EuclideanGeometry.oangle D C B) = 0 := by
      rw [smul_add, h2, EuclideanGeometry.oangle_rev B C D, smul_neg]; simp
    have hx0 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_pos_of_not_collinear hn1
    have hx1 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_lt_pi_of_not_collinear hn1
    have hy0 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_pos_of_not_collinear hn2
    have hy1 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_lt_pi_of_not_collinear hn2
    set x := EuclideanGeometry.angle B A D with hx
    set y := EuclideanGeometry.angle D C B with hy
    have key : (2 : ℤ) • (((x + y : ℝ)) : Real.Angle) = 0 → x + y = Real.pi := by
      intro h
      rw [Real.Angle.two_zsmul_eq_zero_iff] at h
      have hθ : ((x + y - Real.pi : ℝ) : Real.Angle).toReal = x + y - Real.pi :=
        Real.Angle.toReal_coe_eq_self_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      rcases h with h | h
      · exfalso
        have : ((x + y - Real.pi : ℝ) : Real.Angle) = (Real.pi : Real.Angle) := by
          rw [Real.Angle.coe_sub, h]; simp
        rw [this, Real.Angle.toReal_pi] at hθ
        linarith
      · have : ((x + y - Real.pi : ℝ) : Real.Angle) = 0 := by
          rw [Real.Angle.coe_sub, h]; simp
        rw [this, Real.Angle.toReal_zero] at hθ
        linarith
    apply key
    rcases hc : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle B A D).sign with _ | _ | _
    · exfalso
      exact hn1 (EuclideanGeometry.oangle_sign_eq_zero_iff_collinear.mp hc)
    · have ea := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_neg_angle_of_sign_eq_neg_one hc
      have eb := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_neg_angle_of_sign_eq_neg_one (hsign'.trans hc)
      rw [ea, eb] at hsum
      rw [Real.Angle.coe_add]
      rw [← neg_add, smul_neg, neg_eq_zero] at hsum
      exact hsum
    · have ea := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_angle_of_sign_eq_one hc
      have eb := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_angle_of_sign_eq_one (hsign'.trans hc)
      rw [ea, eb] at hsum
      rw [Real.Angle.coe_add]
      exact hsum
  have hpi := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_eq_pi_of_angle_eq_pi D hE.angle₁₂₃_eq_pi
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B C D E : P), A ∈ s → B ∈ s → C ∈ s → D ∈ s → B ≠ D → (line[ℝ, B, D]).SOppSide A C → Sbtw ℝ B C E → EuclideanGeometry.angle D C E = EuclideanGeometry.angle B A D
